scope: Capacity and recovery only. Natural matches unlabelled; no FP/FN or population recall inferred. This cohort is not a new frozen accuracy holdout and is separate from CIFAR natural annotations. No new human review timing.
preprocessing: Pillow EXIF transpose, RGB, longest edge at most 384 with LANCZOS and no enlargement, PNG. Retain original bytes/RGB and normalized byte/RGB hashes and dimensions. This is scaled independent real photos, not original-resolution capacity.
recoveryScope: Real host SIGKILL after committed feature work, feature reuse and final identity checked; not a new large-query/geometry mid-row crash stress test.
